description: Icon Map Slicer is the map slicer for Power BI: a full mapping visual that filters your whole report when people point at the map, with no specialist GIS tools. Draw circles, icons, heatmaps, hexagon grids raised into 3D, 3D columns, arcs, flows and boundaries from your own data, ArcGIS or a catalog of more than 3,000 ready-made layers, then let readers click, lasso, circle or pan the map to filter every other visual on the page. Set it on one of 35+ built-in basemaps or your own, add satellite imagery and 3D terrain, and the selection stays put while readers explore the rest of the report. Selection Click, lasso or circle items on the map, with Ctrl or Shift to add more Select everything inside a boundary from your own files, the Icon Map Catalog or ArcGIS Select everything touching an item, within a buffer distance you choose Travel-time selection: everywhere reachable by car, bike or on foot, calculated inside the visual Filter by map view, so the report shows only what is on screen Unselected items stay on the map, faded, so readers keep their context Selections are saved with the report and work with bookmarks and Sync slicers Data layers Every layer driven by your Power BI data and conditional formatting, and every layer selectable Circles, icons and images, including SVG from your data Heatmaps, and H3, S2, A5 and Geohash grids with 3D extrusion Aggregate points into…
